name: Mavis
says: Good heavens, love! Is this 'Folk Ballad' nonsense supposed to be a meal? It's thick enough to choke a bull while I tried to sip my tea in peace. And why did you go and build another kiosk just so Pea could stare at it? The doilies are slipping off the table again!
wants: A proper lace doily for under those rough bits of paper tearing into my table!
